title: Evaluation of Fluoride Contamination in Groundwater Sources in Palamu District, Jharkhand, India
description: Peer-reviewed article, Journal of Applied Sciences 12(9):882-887 (Science Alert / Asian Network for Scientific Information, 2012-04-15), 6 pages plus cover, Birla Institute of Technology Mesra with IGNOU. Fluoride in drinking-water sources of four blocks of Palamu district (Daltonganj, Bishrampur, Chainpur, Pandu; 23 47-24 23 N, 83 48-84 13 E, 1396 sq km). UNICEF-supported survey of 2864 sources (public wells, private wells, household and public hand pumps, health centres, schools) field-tested with the Jal Tara kit, of which 277 were lab-tested by SPADNS; locations GPS-recorded (data supplied by BIT Mesra). Lab F 0.02-4.2 mg/L (mean 1.63); Table 1 per-block counts and NP max/avg (Bishrampur n=59, Chainpur 53, Daltonganj 152, Pandu 13); Table 2 lab F by depth class (0-50 to >250 ft); Table 3 counts by source type (field n=2864 and lab); Table 4 non-permissible counts by depth for all samples. Highest F (4.2 mg/L) in a public hand pump in Daltonganj at 0-50 ft; 100-150 ft depth most affected (22.6% NP).

title: Groundwater hydrochemistry and consumption patterns in Chandwara community development block of Jharkhand state in India
description: Open-access research article, Applied Water Science 12:60 (2022), 19 pages, received 2020-08-11, accepted 2022-02-03, published online 2022-03-09. 143 groundwater samples (mostly tube-wells, a few dug-wells; dug wells ~20-50 ft, tube wells ~60-550 ft deep) from 39 villages of Chandwara CD block, Koderma district, collected post-monsoon October 2018 to March 2019. Parameters: water temperature, pH, EC, TDS, turbidity, TH, Ca, Mg, alkalinity, Cl, SO4, F, PO4, Fe, Cu, As (test kit), Na and K (n=41 only), total bacterial count and E. coli. description: CGWB digital water-level recorder (DWLR) six-hourly series served by NWDP (dataset code WQT00001; 58 resources nationally). JH 2021-2025: 39519 rows, 20 stations, 10 districts, 2023-03-07..2025-12-31; JH 2026-2030: 13912 rows, 19 stations, 2026-01-01..2026-11-11; OD 2021-2025: 220221 rows, 102 stations, 22 districts, 2022-12-21..2025-12-31; OD 2026-2030: 58936 rows, 101 stations, 2026-01-01..2026-11-11 (live, updated daily). Focus-district stations: Kendujhar 12, Baleshwar 9, East Singhbhum 1, West Singhbhum 1; none in Mayurbhanj or Sahebganj. RL_MSL populated for most rows (137309 of 220221 in OD 2021-2025). Distinct from the 'Telemetry - Hourly' CGWB dataset (NWDP-CGWB-GWL-TELEMETRY-HOURLY), which has no JH/OD resources.
publisher: National Water Data Portal (NWDP), National Water Informatics Centre
author: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB)
access_detail: CKAN package 3782ba15-9b12-46a8-ae44-410b1f84020e; resource sizes match local files; downloaded 2026-11-12 from the development environment via planning/nwdp_cgwb_gwq_gwl_tel_urls.txt; found by CKAN package_search for CGWB after user shared the telemetry-hourly dataset page; dataset slug misleadingly mentions Assam/daily but the package holds all states
rights_notes: CKAN license_id other-open (Other (Open)); Data Access Control Public; no licence text on page; record NWDP terms of use before redistribution
limitations: Values range -39.77 to 33591.91 m, so sentinel/erroneous readings are present and sign convention (negative = below ground?) must be established before use; irregular timestamps (not strictly six-hourly); 2026-2030 files are a moving snapshot retrieved 2026-11-12 and will change on re-download; series start 2022-12/2023-03 only; station names free text
notes: publication_date is the portal modification date of the 2026-2030 resources (2026-11-12); 2021-2025 resources last modified 2026-01-24; metadata_created 2025-03-05.
